The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Sunitha Venkatesh Prasad.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 04-11-2004.

At the time of marriage, the accused have demanded and taken 12 grams of gold ring, expensive watch,
clothes worth Rs.15,000/- and cash of Rs.1,50,000/- as dowry from complainant and her family.

After the marriage, the accused have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by quarreling with her for petty matters, telling her that he was not willing to marry her as she was resembling as servant, quarreled with her to get additional dowry of Rs.One lakh as agreed.

Accused did not take care of CW-1 when she was pregnant, later when she delivered a child the accused did not come to see the child, when CW-1 called accused for naming ceremony of the child, the accused  3  C.C.No.20340/2019 refused to come to the function and asked CW-1 to give him divorce, when she was residing with accused in the year 2005,
accused completely neglected CW-1 and the child and the accused used to quarrel with CW-1 to get additional dowry from her house or to give divorce to him.

Later in the year, 2008 when CW-1 consented for divorce due to the intervention of elders the accused and CW-1 resided separately in a house during this period the accused did not take care of CW-1 and the child, assaulted CW-1 and the child, abused them in filthy language and asked CW-1 to Sunitha Venkatesh Arasad vs Ramesh on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43662847/
2 get money from her house and in the year, 2014 again the accused have quarreled with CW-1 and gave life threat to her and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.67/2019 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

The plea of the accused No.1 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.

 6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  5  C.C.No.20340/2019  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.498A,506, 511 of IPC. ?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused

,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
was examined as PW-1 Smt. Sunitha.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 04-11-2004 and deposed after the marriage,
accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not Sunitha Venkatesh Arasad vs Ramesh on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43662847/
4 subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and deposed accused did not abused and assaulted her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and  6  C.C.No.20340/2019 accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2(a) and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
12. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused  7  C.C.No.20340/2019 Sunitha Venkatesh Arasad vs Ramesh on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43662847/
5 beyond reasonable doubt.

13. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A,506, 511 of IPC.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
